tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, panels, tables, dialogs, POS tiles.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: segmented controls, table header rows when shaded, disabled inputs.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only; never the only thing that marks a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and switch outlines; meets 3:1 on surface-100 and surface-200 in every theme.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on surface-100, surface-200, surface-300 and primary-tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, help text and table headers on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-300.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand colour, used sparingly: primary buttons, links, selected states, the highlighted series in a chart. Also text on surface-100 to surface-300. Tenants override it.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary fills.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary fills.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active tab background, chart bars that are not highlighted; ink text on it.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one decisive action on a screen: POS Charge/Pay, Approve all, Complete. Near-black by default; gold in the Executive preset.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Promotions, discounts and loyalty points as text on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Paid, approved, online, positive change. Text and status dots on surfaces; always with a word.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background of success alerts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending, low stock, offline, near a limit. Text and status dots; always with a word.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of warning alerts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, rejected, void, overdue, destructive actions. Text and status dots; always with a word.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of error alerts.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger fills (destructive buttons).

tokens.name: neutral-dot
tokens.usage: Status dot for neutral states (draft, refunded). Decorative; the word carries the meaning.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Main navigation background. Tenants can switch it light or dark independently of the page.

tokens.name: sidebar-ink
tokens.usage: Navigation labels and icons on sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-active
tokens.usage: Background of the current navigation item.

tokens.name: sidebar-ink-active
tokens.usage: Label of the current navigation item, on sidebar-active.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Divider between the logo block and the navigation, and the sidebar's edge.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: solid 2px outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero figures on the owner dashboard and onboarding titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: POS screens and phone self-service, read at arm's length.
styles.sample: Tap a product to add it to the sale.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default back-office text, table cells, inputs.
styles.sample: Goods received at Kinshasa Gombe store.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, buttons, emphasised table cells.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Help text, timestamps, table headers. Never smaller than this.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Money and quantities in tables and documents, with tabular figures so columns align. Always with the currency code.

styles.name: amount-lg
styles.usage: POS amount due, sale total and KPI figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding; gap between POS tiles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields; phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Desktop page padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum POS touch target height.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, chart bar tops.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, navigation items, POS tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs, sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots, switches, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Only the selected segment of a segmented control and the active sidebar item. Cards use borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus and the POS payment sheet.
